title: Rough backward stochastic differential equations
summary: We develop an intrinsic well-posedness theory for nonlinear backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) driven simultaneously by Brownian motion and a (level-$2$) rough path of finite $p$-variation. Unlike earlier approaches based on smooth approximation or transformation methods, we formulate the equation directly by viewing its solution as a rough semimartingale (in the sense of \cite{friz2023rough}).
